main_measure.name: day-clustered t of the slope of next-day unusual return on forecast (forecast > 0 bars)
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 with mean unusual move > 0 confirms; slope t <= -2 or mean unusual move t <= -2 rejects

decided_by: Confirm: the slope t is 2 or more and the mean unusual move of the cases is above 0.
reading: Cases are all bars with forecast > 0 and a next bar in the same window (horizon 1 bar, so every bar is its own grid cell); the regression is OLS with an intercept and Stata-style day-clustered standard errors; the mean unusual move's t sums the cases' deviations per UTC day.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0003456 on the check folds against +0.0004205 on every fold
